page.overview:
Who is Jake?

Jake is a muscular bearded man. He is dressed in a black vest (blue in Final Fight) with no shirt underneath, blue jeans, and leather boots. In his Shadaloo C.R.I. profile artwork, he had a red bandana tied around his left arm, as well as gold-colored gloves.

Jake is described as having a wild personality, having previously worked as a bouncer in a bar. According to his Shadaloo C.R.I. profile, he is obsessed with boots.

Jake originally worked as a bouncer, having some form of martial arts experience, as evidenced by his jumping kick. The Mad Gear Gang offered to pay him well due to his physical strength, so he became a member.

Jake appears as a common enemy in Final Fight, primarily attacking using a jumping kick technique. He, along with the other members of the Mad Gear Gang, was sent to confront Cody, Guy, and Haggar after the gang kidnapped Haggar's daughter, Jessica.
